caption_L1: Cumulated advertising spending in Sweden from January to November 2020 , by media (in million SEK) is a bar plot. The y-axis shows Advertising spendings in million SEK using linear scale from 0 to 12,000 while the x-axis measures advertising as categorical scale starting at Cinema and ending at Trade journals.
caption_L2L3: It is clear that the organisation focuses on advertising on the TV the most, as it takes up just over a quarter of their budget. The second most popular ways the organisation decided to use are online display and online video. It can be clearly spotted that the graph represents the massive difference between the high use of technological ways rather than using newspapers, magazines or journals.
